Subject: Vendor registration & VAT: GlobalFjord CZ

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the intro. We're ready to get set up as a vendor for Redwood and have a couple of tax/VAT questions before we issue invoices. We're GlobalFjord Logistics s.r.o. (Czech Republic) and can provide the standard vendor form and our VAT certificate, but we need to confirm the following:

- Which Redwood legal entity should we invoice (US entity vs. Redwood Inference Europe B.V.)?
- Will Redwood accept reverse-charge (reverse charge / reverse taxation) for services provided to an EU buyer, or should we include Czech DPH on the invoice?
- What exact PO fields are required so our invoices will match automatically (PO number format, line-item descriptions, currency)?
- Any specific bank remittance instructions (IBAN/BIC) required on the invoice to avoid payment delays?

I've attached our vendor form and can attach the VAT certificate if helpful. We are registered in the Czech Republic; VAT ID is CZ12345678.

Thanks — Irina

Attachments: vendor_form_globalfjord.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2027 13:45:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & VAT: GlobalFjord CZ

Hi Irina — thanks for the quick note and the form. Copying Lauren from Finance to help with VAT specifics. A few clarifying items so we can route this through procurement cleanly: 

- Redwood will generally prefer invoices to Redwood Inference Europe B.V. for EU-sourced suppliers when possible (that allows reverse-charge to apply when both parties have valid EU VAT IDs). Can you confirm the exact legal name and address you want on invoices?
- Please send a scanned VAT cert (PDF) and the company registration number (IČO). You already listed VAT ID which is helpful.
- PO matching: our PO numbers use the format REU-<5 digits>-<year> (e.g., REU-04221-27). Please include the PO number on the invoice header and repeat it on each line item.
- Currency: Redwood Europe pays in EUR for EU vendors; please indicate EUR prices (we can handle currency conversion on our side if needed).
- Bank details: IBAN + BIC are required; we also ask for the beneficiary name to match the vendor registration. If you prefer wire vs. SEPA, let us know.

I've attached our EU PO template so your billing team can map fields. Once we have your VAT certificate and bank attestation, Procurement can issue the PO.

Best,
Soojin
Vendor Onboarding — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>

Date: Thu, 9 Jun 2027 10:30:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & VAT: GlobalFjord CZ

Hi Irina — thanks for the details and attachments. Quick procurement/finance guidance so we don't slow the PO/invoice flow: 

1) Buyer entity: Redwood Inference Europe B.V. will be the buyer for EU vendor relationships in this case. Our EU VAT ID: NL987654321B01 (please include on your invoice if issuing reverse-charge).

2) Reverse-charge: If you issue under reverse-charge, invoice net of VAT and include both VAT IDs and the statement: `Reverse charge — Article 196 EU VAT Directive` on the invoice. Finance will process net invoices and no Czech DPH will be withheld.

3) If you issue with Czech VAT (DPH): we will still pay, but Redwood will reclaim per local tax rules which can add time. To avoid delays: please provide a tax breakdown line (taxable base, VAT rate, VAT amount) and the invoice must clearly reference the PO number (format: REU-XXXXX-27).

4) Invoice remittance: please send invoices to euapac-invoices@redwood.example.com. For payment, beneficiary name must match the company name in the vendor profile. Use the IBAN you provided; SEPA transfers preferred where possible.

5) Required invoice fields (summary): invoice number, invoice date, supplier registered address, supplier VAT ID (DIČ), buyer registered address, buyer VAT ID, PO number, description of services, unit price, quantity, total excl. VAT, VAT rate, VAT amount (if charged), IBAN/BIC.

6) DocuSign: we require a one-time bank attestation for new vendors (link below). Please have your finance contact complete it so we can release PO.

I'll ask Procurement to create REU-03482-27 once the vendor form and bank attestation are complete. Attaching a short supplier invoice instructions PDF for your billing team.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: supplier-invoice-instructions-2027.pdf
